description: START HERE. Federated overview of the APIs.io catalog for a query: the top matching APIs, providers, AND tags in one call, each with its total match count. Filter by tags, artifact types, industry, region, rating band. `limit` is per section. To page/sort the full list of ONE type, use find_apis / find_providers / find_tags; for one entity, get_api / get_provider.

area.description: Area slugs, as find_areas returns them, e.g. ["security"].

artifact_types.description: Artifact types an API must carry, e.g. ["OpenAPI","AsyncAPI","Postman"]. Synonyms fold (MCPServer = MCP).

band.description: Rating bands: exemplar, strong, developing, thin, minimal.

context.description: Optional: why you are asking. One sentence — the task you are trying to complete, or what you expect to get back. Never included in the answer and never used to rank; it is read only when a result turns out to be wrong, which is when knowing the intent is what makes the report actionable.

industry.description: Industry slugs, as find_industries returns them, e.g. ["artificial-intelligence"].

limit.description: Top matches to return per section (apis/providers/tags).

match.description: How multiple `tags` combine: "any" (default, at least one) or "all" (every tag).

min_score.description: Only providers whose Kin Score composite is at or above this, 0-100, e.g. 60.

providers.description: Provider slugs to restrict all three sections to, e.g. ["stripe"].

region.description: Region slugs, as find_regions returns them, e.g. ["north-america"].

return.description: Return only this kind of match. Default: every kind.

sort.description: Order results. Default: relevance with a query, composite (quality) when browsing. `demand` = Fortune-1000 adoption, scoped to the query.

tags.description: Tag slugs. On PROVIDERS this is identity — what the company says it does, from its own apis.yml. A resource or operation term (webhook, saml, order, oai-pmh) will correctly match no provider; use find_apis?tags= for those, or find_providers?api_tags= to reach companies whose APIs merely touch it.

name: apis_io_search
